trials.claim: Lifetime access to Musicsesame Stock Music Library
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Musicsesame - Stock Music Library
trials.reasoning: Buyers report being unable to log in or use the site at all, and users in Asia, particularly Indonesia, must use a VPN because their IPs are not supported. These access barriers materially limit the promised lifetime access, outweighing one review simply calling it a lifetime deal.

exhibits.quote: Website doesn't even work, can't login, can't do anything with it.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports being unable to log in or use the site at all, which directly undermines lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: IP pengguna untuk Asia khususnya Indonesia masih belum didukung jadi untuk membuka harus menggunakan VPN
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports regional IP blocking requiring VPN to open the service, which limits promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: It's definitely one of the top 2 royalty free music lifetime deals I ever had.
exhibits.argument: The buyer explicitly describes the purchase as a lifetime deal for royalty free music.

trials.reasoning: Two buyers independently confirm paying $75 for the deal, with one calling $75 a steal. No exhibit contradicts the $75 deal price.

exhibits.quote: Sadly, this is not refundable either...so that's $75 down the drain.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms they paid $75 for the product.

exhibits.quote: If the tracks suit your needs, $75 is a steal.
